comments.author: chevalierNoir
comments.body:
> If I want to support Japanese, is there a plan and what should I do?

@lisea2017 Japanese TTS is not supported due to some technical issues. But you could train a TTS model for Japanese using the VITS code with some public Japanese speech datasets.
